arb_linguistic_review.summary: Le 1.600 voci turche sono state lette integralmente e confrontate con inglese e italiano. Nessuna voce mancante o testo inglese residuo da tradurre. Proposta una sola integrazione di significato per l’etichetta del riconoscimento del testo sullo schermo.

checks.icu_manual_review: Entrambe le forme plurali (=1 e other) sono complete; il sostantivo turco dopo il numero resta al singolare. I segnaposto sono conservati.
checks.web_and_payment_identifiers: Gli URL e i riferimenti di pagamento sono stati confrontati con le sorgenti e preservati, senza riscriverli nel rapporto.
checks.numeric_content_review: Valori, durate, percentuali e formati media sono preservati; separatori decimali e posizione del segno percentuale sono adattati correttamente al turco.

decisions.decision: Mantenuti i comandi coerenti Duraklat, Devam et, Durdur, çift dokunun, yukarı/aşağı kaydırın e le etichette dei controlli; non introdotte traduzioni libere che cambino gesti o comportamento.
I nomi dei prodotti, delle testate, dei servizi, i nomi delle persone, i formati e i dati importati non vanno tradotti come se fossero etichette UI.
Çalma listeleri / çal in SonarMusic e oynatma listeleri / oynat in SonarTube sono entrambi termini turchi appropriati per i rispettivi contesti, non residui inglesi.
La correzione proposta aggiunge soltanto il risultato già espresso nel label italiano. Non deve cambiare la pipeline, le pause, le condizioni di inclusione del testo o i fallback.

limitations: La revisione è una verifica linguistica e tecnica assistita, non una certificazione da revisore madrelingua.
Questa verifica riguarda gli ARB presenti nella baseline di fase 4. Le nuove chiavi di fase 5 devono essere controllate separatamente prima della consegna.
Flusso reale su dispositivi, pronuncia delle voci TTS e compilazione Flutter non sono stati eseguiti da questo agente.
Schermate fuori dagli ARB, servizi, calendario, manuale e changelog sono assegnati ad altri agenti.

independent_localization_qa.baseline_finding_policy: Discrepancies were verified against phase 4 runtime bodies and ARBs. Both sides are unchanged in phase 5. Kept separately from new issues; no project edits were made by the verifier.
limits: This is static source validation, not Flutter compilation or execution.
Existing Intl pluralLogic calls were compared branch by branch and kept byte-for-byte unchanged; no new plural policy was introduced.
Descriptions in ARB metadata may legitimately differ by locale; placeholder names and explicitly declared types were compared across locales, while all old per-locale metadata was checked unchanged.
Where ARB metadata omits a placeholder type, the existing abstract signature is preserved and runtime signatures are checked against it; no unsupported type is inferred by this checker.

calendar_and_historical_changelog_review.mode: Complete entry-by-entry linguistic review plus Python static verification; no Flutter/Dart test execution.

reference_policy.saints: Italian source is authoritative for names and commemorations. English is used only for schema/date parity because its pre-existing entity mappings include demonstrable mismatches.
reference_policy.quotes: Compared every Turkish entry with supplied English and Italian. Original author suffixes and quote order are preserved. Minor differences between the Italian and English source wording are not new Turkish omissions.
reference_policy.changelog: Every Turkish note compared with English reference; Italian-only content and it_extra remain intentionally outside Turkish, as with the other non-Italian translations.

functional_review.calendar_locale_resolution: CalendarService normalizes tr, tr_TR, tr-TR, and uppercase TR to the bundled tr maps. Unknown locale fallback remains English.
functional_review.quote_rotation: Uses UTC year/month/day normalized to epoch days modulo quote count, so the source does not vary the selected quote due to local DST/time of day.
functional_review.non_italian_saints: Local dataset used for Turkish; no Italian network fallback when a date has no Turkish entry.
functional_review.date_and_reminder_labels: Both calendar UIs use DateFormat with l10n.localeName. Reminder dialogs use localized Material controls and ARB labels; explicit 24-hour formatting is retained.
functional_review.public_holidays: Turkish holidays map remains empty, as for all non-Italian locales in the supplied calendar. No unverified fixed or movable Turkish holidays were introduced.
functional_review.leap_day: The inherited 365-day saint dataset has no February 29 entry; the Turkish path returns null rather than unrelated Italian content. Quote rotation still covers leap dates.
functional_review.movable_feasts: Inherited date-to-saint/feast mapping is not year-aware. Its 2026 movable-feast placement is preserved; this is a source-calendar limitation, not an untranslated Turkish string.

functional_observations_for_root.observation: The saint is loaded only once per mounted page. If app locale changes while this state survives, dates/quotes/labels update but _saint can retain the old language. Sent to root for locale/data invalidation assessment.

test_corrections: Explicit initializeDateFormatting() in setUpAll for standalone calendar date formatting.
Explicitly unmount all four test apps before platform mocks are removed and, for iOS variants, before switching the renderer back to native.
Dispose SonarMusic ScaffoldMessenger timed SnackBar at test end; this error path does not call showStatusMessage or its static timer.
confirmed_against_source: SonarMusicService.search and resolve override signatures match; fake search/resolve perform no real HTTP requests.
CalendarService.getSaint, getSaintAsync and getEventsForDate signatures match; every fake async request made in the calendar test is completed.
Calendar locale/data updates keep the same keyed CalendarDayScreen state, and date formatting delegates are supplied by MaterialApp.
Picker has 18 values for the minimum threshold of 12, and both Turkish I groups and foreign Q/W/X are covered.
Visible active route descriptors expose expected saint and item_0 IDs.
Native iOS renderer is not simulated: iOS test variant deliberately uses the shared Flutter renderer.
final_test_api_review.remaining_validation: Run flutter test test/turkish_ui_completion_test.dart in the complete developer checkout with Flutter/Dart and local path dependencies.

pdf_review.task: Independent read-only review of Turkish PDF export and localized audiobook filename change
pdf_review.result: No implementation blocker found in the final reviewed source. Both review recommendations are implemented: complete font notices and all 150 paragraph markers in the existing pagination test. Flutter execution remains outstanding.

font.sample: İstanbul, Iğdır, Şişli: Çç Ğğ İı Öö Şş Üü âîû. “Türkçe” — özgürlük, ışık ve sağlık; 20 €.
font.turkish_letters_and_diacritics_checked: Çç Ğğ İı Öö Şş Üü âîû
font.limitations: DejaVu Sans is not a universal Unicode font; in particular it does not provide full CJK coverage. The Turkish fix should not be described as support for every writing system.

dependency_api.constructor_verified: PdfTrueTypeFont(List<int> fontData, double size, {PdfFontStyle? style, List<PdfFontStyle>? multiStyle})

implementation_review.font_load: Bundled AssetBundle bytes, no network or device font dependency. ByteData offsetInBytes and lengthInBytes are honored.
implementation_review.resource_cleanup: PdfDocument is created after successful font load. The try/finally awaits document.save() before dispose(), covering draw/save failures.
implementation_review.normalization: Deletes only inherited zero-width transport markers and normalizes CRLF/CR to LF; no blanket non-Latin-1 substitution remains. Turkish letters and typography pass through.
implementation_review.pagination: Retains PdfTextElement.draw with page client bounds and PdfLayoutType.paginate, matching the prior flow. Font metrics can change line/page counts, which is expected.
implementation_review.write_order: DocumentsScreen writes PDF bytes only after PdfExportService.buildPdf completes. Exceptions propagate to the existing localized export error handler.
implementation_review.base_filename: All calls to _generatePdf/_generateDocx/_generateEpub/_generateAudiobook originate from _exportDocument, which first sanitizes the basename once. Source document identity/name is not mutated.
implementation_review.pubspec_changes: Only adds bundled TTF and license asset; dependency/version constraints remain unchanged.

audiobook_change.remaining_difference: DocumentsScreen passes localized documentExportAudiobookSuffix only for the newly exported file.

cases.normalization: Checks all Turkish uppercase/lowercase letters, extended vowels and real punctuation, plus BOM/zero-width/line-ending normalization.
cases.round_trip: Calls the real PdfExportService, reloads saved bytes with PdfDocument(inputBytes: ...) and extracts real text, comparing full normalized output with the complete sample. Meaningful round trip rather than an implementation-mirroring mock.
cases.pagination: Generates 150 Turkish paragraphs, confirms multiple pages, extracts all real pages, and compares every paragraph marker index with the complete ordered sequence 0..149. Also verifies endpoint paragraphs and distinct Turkish words. This detects missing, duplicated or reordered intermediate paragraphs.
cases.missing_font: Injects AssetBundle failure and checks propagation instead of silently returning corrupted substitutions.

test_review.bundle_setup: TestWidgetsFlutterBinding initialized; rootBundle should resolve pubspec assets in a normal flutter test run. Actual run requires the complete developer checkout and SDK.

recommendations_sent.item: Append all copyright/license text from font name IDs 0,13,14 to the distributed license file
In the existing pagination test compare all extracted paragraph marker indices with 0 through 149 in order
recommendations_sent.reason: Current endpoints alone cannot detect missing or duplicated intermediate paragraphs.

validation_limits: No Flutter/Dart SDK was installed or executed.
No PDF was generated by Syncfusion in this environment, so the round-trip and visual outcome are not claimed to pass.
Font coverage and pinned-package API/source checks were executed/read independently.
No mutation of project files by this reviewer.

notes.it: Completata e revisionata la traduzione turca. Migliorati la selezione per lettera dell’alfabeto turco e l’aggiornamento del calendario al cambio di lingua. L’esportazione PDF conserva ora le lettere turche.
notes.en: Completed and reviewed the Turkish translation. Improved selection by letters of the Turkish alphabet and calendar updates when changing the app language. PDF export now preserves Turkish letters.
notes.fr: Traduction turque complétée et révisée. Amélioration de la sélection par lettre de l’alphabet turc et de la mise à jour du calendrier lors d’un changement de langue. L’exportation en PDF préserve désormais les lettres turques.
notes.es: Completada y revisada la traducción al turco. Mejoradas la selección por letras del alfabeto turco y la actualización del calendario al cambiar de idioma. La exportación a PDF ahora conserva las letras turcas.
notes.pt: Tradução em turco concluída e revista. Melhoradas a seleção por letras do alfabeto turco e a atualização do calendário ao mudar de idioma. A exportação para PDF preserva agora as letras turcas.
notes.pt_BR: Tradução para o turco concluída e revisada. Melhoradas a seleção por letras do alfabeto turco e a atualização do calendário ao mudar de idioma. A exportação para PDF agora preserva as letras turcas.
notes.pl: Ukończono i przejrzano tłumaczenie na język turecki. Usprawniono wybór według liter alfabetu tureckiego oraz aktualizowanie kalendarza po zmianie języka. Eksport do PDF zachowuje teraz tureckie litery.
notes.cs: Dokončen a zrevidován překlad do turečtiny. Vylepšen výběr podle písmen turecké abecedy; kalendář se nyní aktualizuje při změně jazyka. Export do PDF zachovává turecká písmena.
notes.de: Die türkische Übersetzung wurde vervollständigt und überarbeitet. Die Auswahl nach Buchstaben des türkischen Alphabets und die Aktualisierung des Kalenders beim Sprachwechsel wurden verbessert. Beim PDF-Export bleiben türkische Buchstaben jetzt erhalten.
notes.zh_CN: 完成并校对了土耳其语翻译，改进了土耳其语字母选择及切换语言时的日历更新。导出 PDF 现在会保留土耳其语字母。
notes.uk: Переклад турецькою мовою завершено та відредаговано. Поліпшено вибір за літерами турецького алфавіту й оновлення календаря після зміни мови. Експорт у PDF тепер зберігає турецькі літери.
notes.ro: Traducerea în turcă a fost finalizată și revizuită. Au fost îmbunătățite selecția după literele alfabetului turcesc și actualizarea calendarului la schimbarea limbii. Exportul în PDF păstrează acum literele turcești.
notes.tr: Türkçe çeviri tamamlandı ve gözden geçirildi. Türk alfabesine göre harf seçimi ve dil değiştirildiğinde takvimin güncellenmesi iyileştirildi. PDF dışa aktarma artık Türkçe harfleri koruyor.
